author: Robin Marx
description:
In Conan the Barbarian #25, after untold leagues of single-minded solitary travel, a cloaked stranger presents himself at the city gates of Tarantia, capital of Aquilonia, demanding to speak to King Conan. Initially rebuffed as a vagrant by the city guards, the anonymous visitor simply sits in the dust and waits patiently outside the gate […]

The post REVIEW: Conan the Barbarian #25 appeared first on Grimdark Magazine.
title: REVIEW: Conan the Barbarian #25
